newsitem.title: ITALY: Italy's Prodi to have new talks with unions Oct 28.
newsitem.headline: Italy's Prodi to have new talks with unions Oct 28.

text.p: Prime Minister Romano Prodi will hold a further round of talks with trade union leaders next Monday to try to resolve outstanding references over Italy's 1997 budget, his office said on Thursday.

It issued the statement after leaders of the three main trades union confederations, CGIL, CISL and UIL said they had not been satisfied with answers to their questions at talks with Prodi on Thursday.
The union leaders said they would meet next Monday to consider possible protest action.
Prodi's office said the talks at the prime ministers office on October 28 would begin at 1100 GMT.
It said the meeting would provide an opportunity to expand on the matters under discussion "in order to arrive at an agreement fast".
